mode: Native PostgreSQL with stock assignment casts for int4, int8 and text, UTF-8 and standard-conforming strings.
structure: Each written or returned field identifies an exact target coordinate and its native role. Preserve the source width independently of the destination width. Ordinary VALUES accepts native signed literals or NULL. UPDATE additionally accepts an old-row field. INSERT SELECT accepts resolved signed expressions, including explicit checked int4 or int8 casts. Field-only RETURNING preserves result names, order and native width.
conditions: Check the writable destination, distinct destination slots, source ownership and ordered result width before publishing. PostgreSQL assigns either signed width to either signed width or to text. A bare NULL receives its destination type in an ordinary INSERT SELECT. Under DISTINCT an untyped NULL has text type and requires a text destination. A checked cast supplies the explicit signed type before DISTINCT. Narrowing range errors are native evaluation failures.
meaning: Copy native signed values exactly on widening and retaining width. A narrowing cast raises 22003 when its value is outside the destination interval. Text assignment produces the native signed decimal value. UPDATE computes all expressions from the old row. RETURNING reads inserted or updated rows and the deleted old rows. Retain NULL, duplicates, order of columns and independent source.
sql: Write native int4 and int8 types on numeric literals and checked casts, emit exact input references and destination names using physical coordinates, preserve DISTINCT and filter, and render RETURNING from validated target coordinates.
observations: Native target and source kind and exact field ownership
Entire affected row bag, result-column names and native type IDs including int8
Exact full before, after and rollback target snapshots plus the unchanged query source
Native narrowing errors, untyped DISTINCT and incompatible-type errors
